A short storyso far

Student, cyber risk analyst and builder of small tools.

I started Computing Science at Douglas College in January 2025 and have kept a 4.00 GPA, which has put me on the Dean's List. I plan to finish my Associate of Science in December 2027 and then transfer to a university to complete a Bachelor's in Computing Science.

Next to classes, I work part-time as a clerk at No Frills. Keeping the shelves accurate and the customers happy keeps me on my toes, and it taught me to stay careful with details and steady when the store gets busy.

In January 2026 I joined Teck Resources as a Cyber Risk Analyst co-op on the Digital Risk and Cybersecurity team. I began with third-party risk assessments, and over two terms I moved into building the tools the team uses.

Outside work I build things I am curious about: a 3D asteroid tracker, a geolocation game with a sarcastic narrator, a language tutor, and a transit reliability tracker. I also tutor classmates in Calculus, Algebra and Discrete Math.

Work atTeck Resources

My co-op ran from January to August 2026. The first term was about learning how risk gets judged. The second was about making that work faster and easier to repeat.

Copilot Studio, Power Automate

AI Risk Assessment Agent

Employees can request an assessment themselves. The agent applies the enterprise rating methodology, writes the report with Word content controls and notifies reviewers. Turnaround went from several days to under 30 minutes.

Power Apps

Digital Asset Travel Threat Assessment App

A proof of concept requested by the CISO, now moving toward enterprise production. It assesses country-level risk to determine whether employees are allowed to take Teck Resources digital assets with them when they travel. Each country is scored on six criteria: safety, surveillance, data rights, infrastructure, cyber reputation and corruption. The result is Low, Moderate, Severe or Critical, and each level follows its own approval path. It generates tickets and tracks their status. ServiceNow and XSIAM integrations are possible next steps.

Ongoing

Risk and compliance automation

A risk register report that pulls several SharePoint lists into one weekly Excel file, SecurityScorecard alert consolidation, Power BI dashboards, support for the Archer GRC migration, third-party vendor risk assessments, and quarterly risk register reviews with managers.
